_intent: Encode the book's argument as a middle-range DYNAMIC model in the causal-loop convention of system dynamics: latent CONSTRUCTS connected by four numbered feedback loops over one shared spine, path-specific MODERATORS attached to single transitions, three OUTCOMES, and seven falsifiable HYPOTHESES that follow from the loops. Single-case (DocAble); directional, not proven; no path coefficients are claimed.
hedge: N=1: one repository, one fleet, one operator, ~20 weeks focused. These are ANALYTIC-generalization claims (about a mechanism and its scope conditions), not statistical generalization to a population. They are stated so future multi-case / longitudinal / controlled work can test them. Directional and middle-range, not fitted.

spine._note: The shared left-to-right system the four loops run over, read clockwise. Each construct id is reused by the loops, moderators, and hypotheses below.

constructs.name: Agentic capacity
constructs.gloss: Model capability, concurrency, and raw implementation rate. The amplifier: velocity clusters latent weakness in time, so failure classes that would arrive months apart under human-paced work land in a single afternoon, close enough to see the structure they share. Distinguish the INTRINSIC driver — the foundation model's inherent ability, exogenous to the loops — from DEPLOYED agentic capacity (feasible task size, concurrency, ambition), which the environment raises: the purple capability-amplification loop feeds back into deployed capacity — the frontier the operator dares attempt — not the model's intrinsic capability.

constructs.name: Effective governed-environment quality (E)
constructs.gloss: The degree to which the environment gives agents a current, task-relevant representation of the system together with coherent, proportionate, machine-actionable coverage of its important obligations. A QUALITY, not a quantity — apparatus count is an indicator, not a substitute. Read E as a conceptual STATE VECTOR E = (R, C, H, Q) over its four dimensions — representation quality, enforcement coverage, coherence, and economy — not a measured scalar index the case could report; a large apparatus raises a dimension of E only when it is coherent, economical, and actually covers the obligations that matter, and can instead be duplicated machinery, stale enforcement, or a tower of governance that lowers E while the control count climbs.

dimensions.question: Are the relevant properties legible in the environment's current models?
Are important obligations covered by controls proportionate to their decidability and risk — hard mechanisms where they fit, judgment-based review where they do not?
Do the mechanisms compose without harmful collision or duplication?
Is the governance burden proportionate to the risk and value it controls?

constructs.name: Agentic work
constructs.gloss: Attempted change against the current task frontier. Capacity drives it; the environment shapes it into realized performance.

constructs.name: Realized performance
constructs.gloss: What the work actually delivers: durable throughput, defect escape, and the human attention each unit of durable output costs.

constructs.name: Governance pressure
constructs.gloss: The experienced gap between the performance the fleet looks capable of and the durable performance it delivers: churn, recurring failure, escaped defect, repeated intervention, control friction. The central experienced driver — the pressure an operator actually feels.

constructs.name: Structural diagnosis
constructs.gloss: The scarce act of judgment that reads a signal as a local defect (repair and move on) or as evidence of a missing model, abstraction, boundary, invariant, oracle, mechanism, or governance seam. Pressure is not yet knowledge; diagnosis is.

constructs.name: Governance adaptation
constructs.gloss: The repertoire that changes E: represent (make structure legible), convert (a recurring failure into a durable mechanism), strengthen (weak guidance into harder enforcement), reconcile (duplicated/conflicting controls), retire (stale or net-harmful governance). Subtractive as well as additive.

loops.name: Bootstrap loop
loops.type_note: An input/initialization, NOT a feedback loop — it seeds the initial environment before any agent runs.
loops.reading: Prior engineering knowledge — inherited architecture, tests, controls, standards, prior incidents, lessons transferred from earlier systems — converts into the initial governed environment E(0). Governance conversion in one project becomes bootstrap knowledge in the next. Lowers the initial failure rate; does not close the red loop.

loops.name: Churn / discovery loop
loops.type_note: Together with L3 forms a BALANCING loop (see B-loop below): the goal-seeking arm that surfaces pressure.
loops.reading: Work outruns a weak environment; the gap surfaces as governance pressure. Velocity amplifies and temporally clusters latent weakness. The red loop ends at structural diagnosis — the scarce work.

loops.name: Governance-adaptation loop
loops.type_note: Together with L2 forms a BALANCING loop: adaptation reshapes E to reduce the churn that drove it.
loops.reading: A structural diagnosis triggers an adaptation (model / convert / strengthen / reconcile / retire); the return arm reshapes E. Later agents inherit a more compact representation, clearer constraints, fewer invalid moves, earlier evidence, narrower seams, more reliable admission conditions.

loops.name: Capability-amplification loop
loops.type_note: A REINFORCING loop (see R-loop below): self-amplifying, keeps moving the target.
loops.reading: A stronger environment raises DEPLOYED agentic capacity — feasible task size, more concurrency, more ambitious requirements, cheaper refactoring, denser use of capacity — the frontier the operator dares attempt, NOT the foundation model's intrinsic capability. The expanded frontier exposes new failure classes and reopens the loop. This is why MAGE does not terminate.

loop_typing._note: System-dynamics causal-loop typing (Meadows convention). Naming the types sharpens the non-terminating claim: the balancing loop drives the environment toward fit; the reinforcing loop moves the target the moment it is reached.

B.reading: churn -> diagnosis -> adaptation -> less churn: goal-seeking, self-damping, toward fit.

R.reading: better E -> more ambition -> new frontier: self-amplifying, reopens the loop.

input.reading: seeds E before any failure; not a feedback loop.

moderators.reading: Fit between the work and the DIAGNOSTIC capability a structural reading needs — largely a human/organizational capacity to read a signal as structural, not the fleet's implementation capability (do not read it as the model/task fit of Part 4). Below fit, pressure arrives but no diagnosis converts it — motion without direction.
Ability or organizational path to modify shared architecture and controls. Need not live in one architect; the failure is a path that terminates in a local patch, leaving the class to recur.
Degree to which important properties can be represented and mechanically checked.
Degree to which mechanisms compose without harmful interaction; the guard against a tower of governance.

outcomes.name: Durable throughput
outcomes.measures: Raw implementation converted into lasting system progress.

outcomes.name: Defect escape
outcomes.measures: Relevant failures reaching later lifecycle stages or production.

outcomes.name: Human-attention burden
outcomes.measures: Human judgment required per unit of durable output. State as a RATE, not a ceiling — per-change attention amortizes even while total governance work grows.

apparatus_measures_caveat: Support ratio, model-coverage fraction, control count, gate count, model-sync rate, control-interaction findings, stale-control rate measure INVESTMENT or ACCUMULATION, not quality. A large apparatus can be effective governance OR duplicated machinery / accidental complexity / stale enforcement / a tower of governance. Each is an input or indicator; effective quality is what the OUTCOMES reveal.

hypotheses.name: Representation leverage
hypotheses.statement: For tasks whose required reasoning state exceeds comfortable implementation-level inspection, a task-relevant and trustworthy model will reduce reconstruction/context cost or increase the scale of work completed at matched quality relative to reasoning from lower-level artifacts alone. The advantage should increase as the required reasoning state grows.
hypotheses.falsifier: Model use at matched recall yields no efficiency gain, lowers quality, adds no predictive power over coverage, or shows no advantage that widens as the required reasoning state grows.

sub_hypotheses.name: Representation efficiency
sub_hypotheses.statement: Task-relevant structured models extend the effective reasoning horizon: they replace implementation-level state with semantically richer abstractions that survive repeated compaction with less loss, reducing context cost and churn without lowering task quality.
sub_hypotheses.falsifier: Model use at matched recall yields no efficiency gain, lowers task quality, or shows no advantage that widens as the required reasoning state grows.

sub_hypotheses.name: Synchronization signal
sub_hypotheses.statement: Model-synchronization measures provide predictive information about later churn or defect escape beyond conventional code-coverage measures.
sub_hypotheses.falsifier: Synchronization measures add no predictive power over conventional code-coverage measures.

hypotheses.name: Representation integrity
hypotheses.statement: Stale, irrelevant, or poorly chosen models will reduce or reverse the benefit in H1; measures of model correspondence and obligation coverage should therefore predict later churn or defect escape beyond conventional implementation-level metrics.
hypotheses.falsifier: Orphaned or drifted surfaces are no more likely than modelled ones to see later churn or escape.

hypotheses.name: Representation-induced determinization
hypotheses.statement: For some system-level obligations, changing from raw implementation to an explicit representation of the relevant state or relation will make a repeatable predicate feasible where per-change evaluation over the implementation otherwise requires semantic reconstruction.
hypotheses.falsifier: Recognition latency does not improve with velocity once exposure opportunities are controlled.

hypotheses.name: Representation induction and innovation
hypotheses.statement: Commodity intelligence can contribute useful engineering representations, first by inducing latent structure from existing systems and, more strongly, by proposing representations that make consequential engineering questions tractable in ways the existing representational repertoire does not. Where those representations can be independently validated and economically maintained, they should extend the effective reasoning horizon of later agents and human engineers.
hypotheses.falsifier: Machine-proposed representations recover no consequential structure a simpler baseline misses and propose none the existing repertoire lacks, or the representations they add cannot be independently validated or economically maintained, so later agents and engineers gain no reasoning reach from them.

hypotheses.name: Mechanized assurance
hypotheses.statement: For obligations that are sufficiently decidable and adequately covered, repeatable independent mechanisms will reduce defect escape relative to assurance that requires proportional per-change human attention; the advantage should widen as autonomous throughput increases.
hypotheses.falsifier: Mechanized coverage adds no protection, or its advantage over review does not widen as human attention saturates.

hypotheses.name: Governance conversion
hypotheses.statement: For recurring failure classes, structural interventions targeted at the class will reduce subsequent recurrence or repeated human attention relative to local repair alone, net of the intervention's carrying cost. The relationship will become non-monotonic when controls accumulate beyond their useful fit.
hypotheses.falsifier: Interventions per durable change stay flat or rise as effective conversion coverage grows.

hypotheses.name: Learning propagation
hypotheses.statement: Engineering lessons will reach later relevant work faster and more consistently when diagnosis is connected to authority over shared, machine-actionable environmental structure than when the lesson remains local or must propagate primarily through interpersonal communication.
hypotheses.falsifier: Increasing environment explicitness or machine-actionability does not reduce propagation latency or increase adoption consistency once communication opportunity is controlled.

hypotheses.name: Environment fit
hypotheses.statement: The effect of increasing agentic capacity on durable throughput, defect escape, and human-attention burden will depend on effective environment quality: capacity gains should translate into more durable progress in stronger environments and into more churn or intervention in weaker ones.
hypotheses.falsifier: Velocity relates to durable throughput the same way regardless of environment quality.

hypotheses.name: Capital return/depreciation
hypotheses.core_quantity: return and carrying cost over time
hypotheses.statement: Useful models, mechanisms, architectures, and procedures will produce measurable reductions in future reconstruction, human attention, rework, or risk over the surfaces they cover; those returns will decline as the assets lose fit, and environments that reconcile or retire depreciated assets will outperform otherwise comparable environments that only accumulate machinery.
hypotheses.falsifier: Split-authority or low-fit settings convert at the same rate and durability as high-fit, effective-authority ones.

propositions.name: Reasoning-Horizon Proposition
propositions.statement: Software engineering is a long-horizon reasoning task. Productivity degrades once the working reasoning state a task requires exceeds the effective reasoning horizon of the human-agent system. Executable models extend that horizon by replacing implementation-level state with semantically richer abstractions whose properties preserve a larger fraction of task-relevant information under repeated compaction.
propositions.falsifier: Holding task and recall fixed, reasoning over a task-relevant model yields no reduction in reconstruction cost or churn versus reasoning over the implementation, and no gain that widens as the required reasoning state grows.
propositions.bounded_claim: MAGE moves the scalability wall; it does not remove it. Models raise the level at which reasoning occurs, delaying the point at which working memory becomes the bottleneck; beyond it, further decomposition and modularity become unavoidable. The horizon extends ONLY when the model is task-relevant, adequately complete, synchronized, usable by the agent, and cheaper to interpret than reconstructing the same facts from code; a model that fails those conditions SHORTENS the effective horizon — it confidently routes reasoning toward a stale or wrong picture the agent then pays to detect and undo.
propositions.reading: The named theory STATEMENT that H4 encodes as a falsifiable HYPOTHESIS. The proposition names the mechanism — a finite reasoning horizon that models extend by acting as better compression domains — and states the limit MAGE draws from it. H4 supplies the testable prediction; the proposition supplies the mechanism and its bound. Registered offered-for-replication (the chapter's global hedge), so it is honestly situated, not asserted.

propositions.name: Compounding-Governance Proposition
propositions.statement: Governed engineering environments compound: as recurring engineering judgment converts into durable mechanisms, an increasing fraction of future effort over the failure classes those mechanisms cover can extend capability rather than re-solve settled problems, so the environment grows more capable of supporting safe change — for as long as the accumulated engineering capital stays fit. These are returns to accumulated engineering capital over covered classes, not global returns to total governance expenditure.
propositions.falsifier: As effective conversion coverage grows, the fraction of future effort available to extend capability does not rise and per-change cost does not fall.
propositions.bounded_claim: The returns compound but are not unbounded, and they attach to engineering capital (quality), not apparatus quantity. Two ways accumulation stops compounding: apparatus pushed past the point of fit (the tower-of-governance band of the churn curve) and capital that outlived its fit. That is why mature adaptation is subtractive — reconcile and retire manage capital depreciation, not merely bad apparatus. A third failure hides inside the first two: accumulated capital that has drifted from the system it models does not merely stop paying — it CONFIDENTLY MISDIRECTS, steering later work against a picture no longer true, which is worse than no capital at all.
propositions.reading: The named theory STATEMENT that H6 encodes as a falsifiable HYPOTHESIS. The proposition names the compounding-governance mechanism — conversions bank engineering capital that lowers the recurring reasoning a future change demands; H6 supplies one testable signature of it (per-change human attention falls as classes convert). H6 is anchored on L3, the green governance-adaptation loop (failure to judgment to conversion to a more capable environment); the full compounding dynamic is the L3-to-L4 (green-to-purple) COMPOSITION, where the more-capable environment raises ambition onto a new frontier. So it is wider than H6's single observable and does not mean the fleet does less — it means higher-leverage, more-ambitious work at a falling per-change cost. Registered offered-for-replication (the chapter's global hedge), honestly situated, not asserted; parallel in form to the Reasoning-Horizon Proposition (different mechanism — H6 amortization vs H4 representation leverage — different falsifier).

corollaries.claim: Speed and stability do not trade
Conversion gets faster as tooling matures
The substrate heals faster as it accretes controls
Grammar coverage better predicts format-space escapes
A fidelity gate reduces silent corruption

corollaries.status: Subjective consequence of H6; future work

relations.name: The churn relation
relations.substantive_claim: dc/dE < 0, read as a directional sign over one dimension-bundle of the E-vector (not a fitted slope): churn share falls monotonically as effective environment quality E climbs, and keeps falling even in an overgrown estate — because overgrowth is precisely what LOWERS E. The non-monotonic churn curve is drawn against a DIFFERENT x-axis — governance-apparatus QUANTITY, not E: push apparatus past fit and churn rises again from collisions, false positives, latency, context burden, and constraints that block legitimate work, because quantity does not monotonically raise E. Churn is monotone in E, non-monotone in apparatus quantity; the two axes must not be conflated.
relations.shape: in E (monotone): churn falls as E rises, through the fit point and beyond. in apparatus QUANTITY (a different, non-monotone axis): under-governed -> churn high ; well-fit -> churn lowest ; overgrown -> churn rises from friction, because quantity past fit lowers E

relations.name: Attention-based versus mechanized control
relations.form: eps_review ~= p*(1 - r(V)) ;  eps_control ~= p*(1 - kappa)
relations.substantive_claim: p = risk-weighted defect-opportunity rate; r(V) = finite-review coverage, which falls as velocity rises so eps_review climbs toward p; kappa = mechanized-coverage fraction, which a mechanism applies every change regardless of throughput. For adequately scoped mechanisms kappa is LESS sensitive to throughput than r(V), so the escape gap widens with velocity. kappa counts effective REPEATABLE mechanisms, of which determinism is one strong class — anomaly detection, metamorphic and differential testing, and model-based semantic review are statistical yet repeatable and count toward kappa when adequately scoped.

research_agenda.study_design: Multi-project longitudinal panel with environment-quality variation
Subsystem-level panel tracking model gaps, churn, and escapes
Organizational comparison of diagnosis and authority pathways

Instrument one failure class from first occurrence through recurrence -> structural recognition -> governance intervention -> later recurrence or escape (tests the discovery and adaptation loops directly)

evolution._note: The empirical kernel and the later extensions are epistemically different and must not be blurred.

kernel.source: davis2026cheapcode (Cheap Code, Costly Judgment) — first twelve weeks of the DocAble build
five_step_loop: the engineer classifies the failure as local or structural
structural failures are converted into governance
later agents inherit a narrower, more explicit action space
repeated conversions raise the environment's capacity to absorb future work

extensions: Ex-ante (bootstrap) governance became a first-class path, complementary to ex-post conversion.
Modeling became a coequal route to governability (the Modeling Principle).
Governance accumulation proved non-monotonic — mature adaptation includes reconciliation and retirement.
The process became visibly multi-loop (bootstrap / churn / adaptation / amplification).
